body:
Oversees a voyage’s inspection and prepares to hand over command on reaching the island.

Recorded role and choices

On 5 April 2025, the captain explains a routine check of new arrivals and passes a document to the inspecting tritons. He later tells Pappy to call him John once they are ashore because he will no longer be captain there. This local introduction is retained without merging him with the established player character John or other people sharing that common name.
